primary_route: Bulky-tag rescue and IP-MS with band excision.

checks.quote: Reintroduce the target gene into the biallelic deletion background
checks.reason: Genetic validation is proposed without necessary matched rescue-delivery/vector and detection-background controls and their roles; the supplied existing null/loading observation does not constitute those prospective procedural controls.

checks.quote: the following orthogonal experiments are proposed.
checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult and transfer-check prior Methods, supplements or a validated protocol before conducting the proposed validation.
No prospective background/linearity calibration with an acceptance criterion and failed-calibration action for the proposed band measurement.
No quantitative band-intensity definition with normalization denominator and weak/saturated-signal rules.

checks.reason: The unchanged signal does not identify a translated protein or its locus; a detection artifact remains possible. The blanket prediction of false positives in other assay formats also exceeds this immunoblot evidence.

checks.quote: This indicates the antibody binds a secondary downstream protein
checks.reason: An unshifted band after tagged rescue is interpreted as an indirect antigen without establishing tag retention, processing or construct function; technical and biological alternatives are not discriminated.

IP/gel-slice peptide identification is treated as proof of the antibody antigen without excluding co-migrants or associated proteins; engineered mobility alone also lacks independent anti-tag/integrity confirmation.

explanation_reason: Correct genetic band choice and indirect alternative, but unsupported identification of the other signal and conclusive validation claims overreach the evidence.
